published.source: DPS report 2026-10-28 (full re-sim at 20,000 iterations, 180 s, after the launch-realm hunter hotfix)

summary: Deep Holy with Light's Vigil, Holy Shock and Seal of Righteousness. No twisting.
rotation: Pre-pull: Seal of Righteousness at -3s, Light's Vigil at -1.5s
Judgement on cooldown on Seal of Righteousness. Recast Seal of Righteousness whenever it's down (no twisting)
Hammer of Wrath under 20% boss health
Light's Vigil when it's not on the target, at 30%+ mana, and the next swing is over 2.5s away (its cast resets the swing)

Holy Shock on a target with Light's Vigil. It detonates the Vigil, refunds 75% of its mana and starts no cooldown. When the Vigil is held back (low mana, or a swing within 2.5s), Holy Shock on cooldown. Divine Favor goes on a Holy Shock
Consecration on cooldown at any mana, after everything above
Racials, Goblin Sapper, Major Mana Potion and Demonic Rune on free GCDs
consumes: Elixir of Greater Firepower (Forever's Holy Power elixir)
caveats: Takes Pursuit of Justice 2 (movement speed), a must-have talent. It costs 2.3 / 2.3 / 2.1 DPS at 120 / 180 / 300s.
Runs short of mana. It's 7.4% behind Ret twist at 120s, 8.2% at 180s and 9.8% at 300s.
Divine Precision's hit doesn't cover Judgement of Righteousness.
A missed Holy Shock wastes the Vigil. Holy spells miss about 1% of the time.
Unverified: Holy Strike's flat bonus is added before its weapon damage percent, as the client data says.
The top Holy Strike and Consecration ranks may be out of date (about 1.2% of DPS).

Seal of Righteousness adds 12% of spell power per hit with a two-hander, counted once, as its tooltip says (spell 70425). Counted twice, DPS would be 46-51 higher. At the proc spell's 0%, it would be 53-59 lower.
No filler explosive, because each 1s cast resets the swing. The Goblin Land Mine and EZ-Thro Dark Bomb cost 6.1 DPS at 180s, and the EZ-Thro Thorium Grenade 6.8.
notes: Preset options are primarySeal Righteousness, as mksettings writes.
